scope: Published 240-case development regression corpus. Date/name and timestamp-field counterexamples are covered by deterministic boundary tests, separate from this live-model accuracy denominator.
changes: Keep literal evidence tied to its role and occurrence; exclude entity evidence when choosing the timestamp field. Names such as Created, Updated and Entered cannot choose a timestamp or conflict with an explicit date clause. Prompt text, model settings, dataset and expected labels are unchanged.
recording_note: Latest live takes 6-8 contain the same requests, response text and token counts as shipped takes 0-2. The redundant set is omitted; retained recordings preserve their original provider metadata. Live timing is measured in the live report.
